name: Strata Custom GGUF & DeepSeek Empirical Multi-Turn Qualification Protocol
author: Antigravity/MILSPEC-Codex Standard

evaluation_tiers.name: Bounded Container Inspection & Shard Resolution
checks: Bounded header read (<= 64 MiB, <= 8192 keys, <= 65536 tensors)
Tensor rank <= 4 and checked product bounds (GHSA-vgg9-87g3-85w8)
All split shards present and strictly continuous (ordinal 0..N-1, zero missing shards)

evaluation_tiers.name: Architecture & Steering Boundary Isolation
checks: Architecture family matching (dsv41 for DeepSeek MLA, qwen for Qwen/Bonsai)
Refusal vector isolation (model_family match required, cross-family steering strictly rejected)
Orthogonal projection and norm-preserving reflection guarantees

evaluation_tiers.name: Live Hardware Admission & Dynamic Launch Budget
checks: Live available physical RAM >= Planned Host RAM + 4.0 GiB OS headroom
Live available system commit >= Planned Commit + 4.0 GiB headroom
Live free GPU VRAM >= Planned VRAM + 2.0 GiB headroom
Disjoint memory region accounting with zero double-counting

evaluation_tiers.name: Empirical Inference & Process Lifecycle
checks: Minimum 1 real engine launch with non-zero invocations
Minimum 10 non-zero generated tokens (empty output rejected)
Distinction between natural EOS ('stop') and stress limit ('length')
Cryptographic binary hash match (zero placeholder hashes)
Cryptographic raw log digest verification with zero hash drift
Clean server rollback with zero orphaned zombie threads or processes
